body.label: Target
body.html: One enemy within melee Weapon Range.

body.label: Effect
body.html: On success, deal 1 weapon Damage. After resolving, you and one willing ally within 2 units each move up to 2 units; alone, move 2 units.

surges.html: One moved creature may ignore movement Reactions from the target.

rider.title: Authority - Example
rider.html: Spend this Authority when one moved creature is next missed before your next turn: it becomes Rallied and may move 1 unit toward the other; alone, any direction.
